label: Hold-out error
subgoals: Hold out simulated points from the fit
Compute the root-mean-square prediction error on them
Compare the error with the margin of the decisions the surrogate drives

label: Leave-one-out without refitting
subgoals: Compute the ordinary residual of the point
Divide it by one minus the leverage
Sum the squared leave-one-out residuals for PRESS

label: Model size against data
subgoals: Count polynomial coefficients as k plus d choose d
Keep several simulations per coefficient or regularize
Restrict trust to the region the training data covers
